Rewrite the equation: $|x-4| - 10 = 2$ gives $|x-4| = 12$.

- Case 1: $x - 4 = 12$, so $x = 16$.
- Case 2: $x - 4 = -12$, so $x = -8$.

The proposed solution errs in Case 2. It writes $-(x-4) - 10 = 2$, which gives $-(x-4) = 12$, so $x - 4 = -12$ and $x = -8$. The proposal instead wrote $x - 4 = -8$, which dropped the 10 from the constant term. The possible values are therefore 16 and -8, and their product is $16 \times (-8) = -128$.

Check: $|16-4| - 10 = 12 - 10 = 2$ and $|-8-4| - 10 = 12 - 10 = 2$. Both are solutions.
